hypotheses.title: Power-Scaled Tail Amplification of Industry LEAPS VRP
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Applies signed_power(rank - 0.5, 2) to amplify high-conviction extreme options mispricings while suppressing middle uninformative noise. This expands the return spread of long-dated LEAPS VRP, directly boosting annualized margin and driving Fitness from 0.91 past 1.10 without increasing turnover.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if non-linear power scaling causes weight concentration exceeding truncation limits.
